name: @sos-2/meta-evolution
description: SOS 2.0 Self-Evolution + Meta-Adaptation (Work Order W16, parallel slot A): a pure, deterministic META-EVOLUTION orchestrator that applies SOS to itself WITHOUT allowing evolution to weaken governance — strict OBJECT/META separation (the object loop runs the W15 brownfield golden fixtures; the meta loop proposes typed, versioned MetaChange records against the SOS PROCESS itself), meta-proposals generated through the package registry (R24 reuse — SOS internals consume the same package mechanism) and ranked by Pareto + quality-diversity (R12 applied to internals), a NON-DISABLEABLE governance guard (typed rejections; the guard is outside the evolvable surface), adaptation-effectiveness measurement on the frozen section-11 axes through the fixed-seed simulator (simulated outcomes marked — never intervention evidence), authority-aware decision + promotion (ASK is first-class), ROLLBACK with a recovery-control-shaped declaration and EXACT process restoration, and LIABILITY MEMORY — failed self-changes retained forever as failure memory with reduced future proposal probability (R19) — with the traceability invariant that every stage handoff is a typed spine trace link and the full result is ONE connected semantic subgraph from MetaChange proposal to decision to applied revision or rollback + retained failure (spec/architecture.md section 16, R3/R13/R14/R19/R20/R31).
